## Headroom Learned Patterns
*Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-10-24 — do not edit manually*

### Tool usage
*~3,500 tokens/session saved*
- `mcp__headroom__headroom_retrieve` requires `hash` arg; never call it empty. Take hash preceding compressed output (`[N items compressed ... Retrieve more: hash=...]`) and copy it verbatim before calling.
- Pipeline review-finish: read `review.json`, `result.json`, `transcript.md`, `rv.err` in one parallel Read batch, write `.review/review-<n>-tasks.md` file via `bk.ps1`.
- Pipeline iterate: run git/bk probes (`git fetch`, `git log origin/main..`, `bk.ps1 peek`) in one batched PowerShell call instead of many sequential ones; compressed diff output is retrievable by hash, so avoid re-running `git show`/`git diff` variants to see the rest.
